Overfitting checks

Quick checks of the trade list

Quick checks

From the trade list, no rerun: 200 runs each, seed 0

0 passed, 3 failed, 0 not judged, 1 informational.

Passing a check proves nothing on its own. These checks read the run's own trades: a failure says the edge is fragile or small next to the noise of those trades, and none of them can see a strategy picked as the best of many tried. A check with too little to judge says not judged and why, and never passes.

1,108 closed trades; the checks need 30 to judge

Notes

Method, assumptions & warnings

How the figures were computed

Returns are time weighted: cash flows move the equity but are not returns. Each IST session date contributes one return, from the last equity point of the date.

Volatility, Sharpe, Sortino and alpha are annualised with 247.89 sessions a year: the NSE calendar in 2021 to 2026, holiday data sourced. CAGR uses elapsed calendar time.

Risk-free rate 0.00% a year, compounded down to 0.0000% a session.

Every drawdown figure is a fall, so it is zero or negative. The benchmark's figures are measured as the strategy's are, on its known session returns. Each metric's definition shows on its label; every definition cites its source in the documentation of openalgo.backtest.metrics.

Assumptions

What the run assumed, and every warning

base1m
productCNC
entry_fromNone
entry_untilNone
square_offNone
fillnext_open
quantity_modevenue
sizingwhole shares and whole lots; an order with no quantity is sized at the decision close and keeps 2 percent of its budget in cash for the move to the next open (the engine's cash buffer, the same in live trading), then takes off its estimated charges; bt.size sizers and target() keep no buffer, and rebalance keeps its own cash_buffer
costszerodha (contract-note rounding)
slippagedefault table
capital1000000.0
max_daily_lossNone
risk_basisgross
after_risk_exitlock_session
drawdown_haltNone
cooldownNone
max_positionsNone
max_holdNone
leverageNone
max_addsNone
max_positionNone
min_spacingNone
max_riskNone
allow_averaging_downFalse
reinvestTrue
